findings.title: Off-by-one error in the loop condition: `i <= startIndex + pageSize` iterates pageSize + 1 times instead of pageSize tim
findings.description: Off-by-one error in the loop condition: `i <= startIndex + pageSize` iterates pageSize + 1 times instead of pageSize times. The condition should be `i < startIndex + pageSize`. This causes each page to return one extra element (stealing the first item from the next page), breaking pagination boundaries and producing inconsistent results across pages.
